aboutExtra: Practice can be a starting point for someone new to yoga or a way to maintain a personal routine. Each session gives you dedicated time to move, breathe and slow down.
practiceTitle: A practice at your own pace
practiceIntro: With the Mediterranean close by, Mandala Yoga Santa Pola offers a place to pause and make time for mindful movement. The centre has been associated with practices at different rhythms: some invite you to stay in a posture and notice your breath, while others flow from one movement to the next.
practiceHatha: Hatha Yoga brings together postures, breathing and concentration. Its measured pace gives you time to notice body alignment and transitions, whether you are starting out or maintaining a regular practice. People come to the mat for different reasons: to improve mobility, ease daily tension or find a quiet moment.
practiceTaiChi: The centre has also been associated with Tai Chi. Its slow, precise sequences focus on coordination, balance and continuous movement. Hatha Yoga offers time to explore a posture; Tai Chi places more attention on the flow between gestures.
practiceVinyasa: Earlier posts also mention Vinyasa, a more dynamic form of yoga in which breathing accompanies transitions between postures. Groups and class types may change, so ask the centre about current sessions.
